thread:
mo: Heads-up: we've got a rollback-window decision to unpin runtime v5.0.0 in us-west due to increased tokenization errors with llama-compact on long sequences. Errors dropped after routing back to v4.9.2. Proposing staged unpin with clear exit criteria.
claire: share the short failure sample and numbers?
diego: telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/us-west/llama-compact -> token_error_rate: 0.6% baseline 0.02%, us-west 1.9% during peak. Repro: sdk-run --model llama-compact --seq 2000 --runtime 5.0.0 -> tokenize_error at ~1024.
mo: log sample: "ERR tokenizer: unexpected_byte_sequence at offset 1027". Reverting nodes to 4.9.2 reduced errors to baseline.
sophia: We should avoid global rollbacks. Staged unpin in region makes sense. Does deploybot support staged unpin percentages?
deploybot: deployctl unpin staged supported. You can unpin by percentages: 10/25/50/100 over windows. Submit unpin_request UQ-8811 with scope=us-west, from=5.0.0, to=4.9.2, stages=[10,25,50,100], windows=[15m,20m,30m,60m].
claire: Proposed exit criteria: token_error_rate <0.1% for 30m at each stage and no new customer retries >0.5% over baseline. If criteria fail at any stage, rollback to 5.0.0 and escalate SDK.
diego: SDK PR 5022 addresses tokenizer boundary handling. CI green except flaky token-fuzz test. Link: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/5022.
mo: ops runbook: https://runbook.redwood/pinning -> unpin staged steps + rollback procedure.
ops-bot: checklist: [ ] unpin_request created, [ ] approvals, [ ] stage 1 applied, [ ] monitoring active, [ ] rollback criteria set.
sophia: Suggest we also add synthetic probes for offsets 1000-1100 and add debug headers to routed requests so SDK can capture failing traces.
claire: release note stub: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3435 - "us-west temporary staged unpin from runtime v5.0.0 -> v4.9.2 due to tokenizer boundary errors on llama-compact; SDK PR 5022 in review."
oncall: Oncall: please confirm SLA risk and customer-impact windows.
mo: SLA impact low for now; small retry spikes only. We'll proceed with staged plan in 10m after approvals.
diego: approve
claire: approve
deploybot: Approvals recorded. Creating unpin_request UQ-8811. Scheduled to start in 10m.
ops-bot: Stage 1 (10%) applied. Monitoring dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/us-west/unpin-UQ-8811.
sophia: stage1: token_error_rate dropped to 0.15% at 12m. Still above 0.1% threshold, but trending down. Recommend wait full 15m window before deciding.
mo: agree. hold for 5m.
ops-bot: At 15m: token_error_rate=0.09% stage1 -> meets criteria. Proceeding to stage2 (25%).
diego: Stage2 live. Watchdog configured to auto-rollback if token_error_rate >0.4% at any point.
claire: stage2 metrics at 18m: token_error_rate=0.05%, retries stable. Proceed to stage3 in 20m.
sophia: Adding note: if we need to extend unpin beyond 36h, coordinate CS and legal (export controls on tokenizer).
ops-bot: Stage3 (50%) applied. Monitoring.
mo: Stage3 stable at 25m. token_error_rate=0.03%. Good to go to 100% after 30m window.
deploybot: Applying final stage: 100% routing to 4.9.2 for us-west now.
claire: Final check: p99 latency unchanged, cost delta negligible. Good.
ops-bot: Complete checklist: [x] unpin_request created UQ-8811, [x] approvals, [x] staged unpin applied, [x] monitoring active, [x] rollback not needed.
mo: filing postmortem ticket and will attach failing test id (token-fuzz-1027) and SDK PR 5022. Thanks all.
